market_name: Will India strike Pakistan by December 31, 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability spike is corroborated by newswire (LoC incidents, diplomatic statements) or is thin, single-trade noise. Watch INDA pre/after-hours and Nifty futures.
time_plan.1h: Compare INDA move to broad EM (EEM) to isolate India-specific risk vs global beta; check USD/INR NDF reaction.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess if Indian/Pakistani official statements confirm or deny; look for VIX/India VIX moves and options skew.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether move persisted or mean-reverted; check Asian cash session open reaction in Nifty.
time_plan.12h: Mark final INDA return vs entry; determine if escalation narrative held or faded, and whether the market signal led public reporting.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp upward move in the implied probability of an Indian strike on Pakistan signals rising South Asian conflict/escalation risk. Cross-border military action raises equity risk premia, pressures Indian multinationals and foreign portfolio flows, and would typically push broad Indian equity proxies lower. INDA is the most liquid US-listed India equity vehicle and captures aggregate risk sentiment better than any single name.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check NDF forwards for INR; confirm whether move is news-driven or market-thin.
time_plan.1h: Watch for RBI intervention signals that could cap INR depreciation; compare to broader DXY move.
time_plan.2h: Assess oil price co-movement (India is an oil importer; conflict + oil spike compounds INR weakness).
time_plan.6h: Re-check during Asian session liquidity for sustained INR direction.
time_plan.12h: Mark USD/INR vs entry; judge whether FX confirmed the escalation signal or RBI smoothing muted it.

predictions.reasoning: Escalation risk typically triggers safe-haven USD demand and capital outflow fears, weakening the rupee (USD/INR up). FX is a cleaner, deeper conduit for geopolitical risk than equities, though the RBI actively manages INR, dampening magnitude. A genuine strike-probability jump would widen the risk premium on the rupee.

evidence_used: Market question measures probability of an Indian aerial strike on Pakistani territory by end-2026
Historical pattern: India-Pakistan escalation (e.g., Balakot 2019) produced short-lived equity dips and INR weakness
INDA and USD/INR are liquid proxies for India risk sentiment
Strict resolution criteria (aerial strike only) means probability moves reflect genuine kinetic-escalation odds
uncertainty_notes: A probability move may reflect illiquid, single-participant trading rather than real information
Long horizon (Dec 2026) means a probability spike need not imply imminent action within 12h
RBI intervention heavily manages INR, muting FX signal
Indian markets have historically shown resilience and fast mean-reversion to border tensions

llm_justification.summary: This market prices the odds of an Indian aerial strike on Pakistan. A sharp upward move in implied probability signals rising South Asian escalation risk, which would plausibly pressure Indian equities (INDA down) and weaken the rupee (USD/INR up) via risk-premium and safe-haven channels. However, the long resolution horizon, India's historical market resilience, RBI FX smoothing, and the noise of thin prediction-market trading all limit conviction. Neither mapping cleanly clears the 700bps tradable threshold in base case; these are modest, low-confidence directional reads.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine new escalation information, not noise
Markets interpret higher strike odds as negative for Indian risk assets
Proxies (INDA, USD/INR) are sufficiently exposed to India geopolitical risk
failure_modes: The probability move is already-public news fully priced into assets, yielding no 12h reaction
Thin prediction-market liquidity creates a false signal that reverses
India equities shrug off tension as they often have historically (weak/short-lived move)
Long 2026 horizon decouples probability changes from any near-term asset reaction
RBI intervention neutralizes the INR signal
Base-case magnitude falls well short of the 700bps tradable bar, making this non-tradable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
